name: faq-two-column
title: Two-column FAQ
description: Sticky intro and contact card on the left, an accordion of questions on the right.

standards.purpose: Answer the questions that block a decision, in the visitor's own words.
useWhen: Recurring objections can be answered in two or three sentences.
doNotUseWhen: The answer needs a support conversation or legal review.

rules.check: Each accordion item holds one question and its answer.
Answers stay under roughly 80 words; longer material belongs on its own page.
The trigger exposes aria-expanded and controls its panel.
